figurative_meaning_en: Bewildered or losing one's wits in times of crisis
similar_in_english: Lose one's head in a crisis
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদকালে বুদ্ধিনাশ হয়ে গেল, তাই সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারল না।
যুদ্ধের সময় অনেকেই বিপদকালে বুদ্ধিনাশ করে ভুল করে ফেলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He lost his wits in the crisis and couldn't make the right decision.
During the war, many panicked under pressure and made mistakes.
note: This idiom highlights the human tendency to falter intellectually during emergencies, a common theme in Bengali folklore.
